$comment: Machine-readable Classic/Platinum fidelity contract. verify-design validates this file and its live semantic-role tokens. Numerical ranges and proposed token-name patterns remain reference material; they never require an unused token or override CLAUDE.md's current product decisions.

enforcement.rule: A proposed token becomes enforceable only after a real component consumes it. verify-design must not create or require declarations merely to satisfy this contract.

finePointer.note: Compact and visible on mouse/trackpad; must not read as a generic modern web page.

coarsePointer.note: Visible controls may grow; do not rely on invisible hit layers alone.

touchTarget.rule: This is historical planning guidance, not a blanket size gate. Current visible and hit geometry follows CLAUDE.md and the owning component's tested responsive contract; never add an unused token or an oversized invisible layer just to satisfy this number.

geometryTokens.rule: Visual size, hit size, and layout slot may differ but must use distinct tokens; a large slot must not push a centered title away without reason.

classic.material: smooth monochrome SVG, no pixel mode, no low-res bitmap fallback
classic.shellLanguage: title-bar striping, 1px window border, button outline, scroll track, selection inversion

typography.chinese: baseline, line-height, weight, and vertical padding corrected per-script without inflating all chrome

classic.svg: no non-uniform scaling, cropping, or blur filter at 16/32/desktop sizes

bevel.pressed: inverted bevel plus 1px optical content shift, no outer-size change or relayout

decoupledRoles.scrollbarThumb: light blue-purple #9999ff, a dedicated token decoupled from selection; intentional Mac OS 9 default, not a user-facing setting
decoupledRoles.desktopPattern: azul tile retained as a Mac OS 9 scheme; never drives control color
decoupledRoles.focusRing: independent token, may relate to selection color

menu.panel: gray raised surface, 1px black border, hard shadow
menu.defaultButton: clear outer ring, not a modern blue primary button

rules.hover: push buttons never change geometry, lift, or enter pressed on hover
rules.pressed: entered only via pointerdown/Space/Enter or equivalent activation
rules.touch: pressed feedback appears immediately on touchstart and releases on touchend/cancel
rules.stuckState: no stuck pressed state after rotation, window switch, or pointercancel
rules.focus: focus-visible is independent of hover and drawn on real control bounds
rules.selectedFocus: selected and focus may be visible simultaneously
rules.disabled: full geometry preserved, expressed via contrast/pattern/existing recipe

allowed: TDI vertical rail to compact stack
bottom actions wrap or pin to safe inset
forbidden: collapse every app into an untitled web page
reload or clear unsaved state on rotation
global zoom or transform:scale() desktop scaling

forbiddenEffects.appLevelBodyDataThemeSelector: only app-specific misuse is flagged; the sanctioned html/body[data-theme] theme blocks are exempt

allowedExceptions: charts, WebGL, media, and creative labs
modern content exceptions written into the fidelity doc
